id: title:Gilbert09:retry connect time refusal during a source shutdown

review.posthog_relevance: Adds transient error classification and tests for database connection retry behavior during smart/fast shutdown, supporting the implementation of connection recovery rather than complete activity failure.
review.reason: Adds a transient error message classification and tests for database connection retry behavior during smart/fast shutdown. This supports the implementation of connection recovery rather than complete activity failure.
review.uncertainty: The actual implementation of the retry behavior is not shown, only the classification and tests, so tier 3 is not supported.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the retry behavior, only the classification and tests. The connection and retry behavior is not shown, so tier 3 is not supported.

observations.behavior: Adds a new transient error message to the retryable classification.
observations.posthog_connection: Retrying database connections during a smart/fast shutdown, rather than failing the whole activity, while the source is going down.
